create_recorder_instance: create a Recorder instance to track HITL job management statistics with a configurable update interval
set_job_stat: set a job statistic value for a specific job type like interaction or retrain
set_meta_data: set metadata fields like batch_id, name, or cost on the Recorder instance
record_job_start_end: record the start and end timestamps of a specific job type using set_job_start and set_job_end
save_records_to_s3: save the local job management record JSON file to the remote S3 bucket
